name: slot-not-held-outside-mac-stages
about: #192: the held slot counts only the Mac's own stages. With active_agents 2 and one slot taken, the Mac runner (only_resources [macos], seen just now) takes review only while the macos item waits in build, so the Mac would not claim it: nothing is held and the dev box's runner takes the last slot. (The control's stop makes the Mac's claim a check-in that takes nothing.)
